title: Solana (SOL) 📉 -2.7%

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might Solana’s recent dip signal about blockchain’s evolving role in finance and infrastructure?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Solana’s high throughput and low latency make it ideal for DeFi and NFTs, but scalability challenges persist under extreme load.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If adoption grows too fast, governance risks centralization and user data could be exploited by powerful actors.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are experimenting with proof-of-history and off-chain computation to improve scalability and transparency.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where Solana powers seamless cross-border payments with strong privacy and fair consensus could be within reach.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Solana’s trajectory may define how blockchain balances speed, ethics, and trust in the next decade.
